questionGroups.html:
Questions 21 and 22

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

Which TWO parts of the introductory stage to their art projects do Jess and Tom agree were useful?

Questions 23 and 24

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

In which TWO ways do both Jess and Tom decide to change their proposals?

Questions 25–30

Which personal meaning do the students decide to give to each of the following pictures?

Choose SIX answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-H, next to Questions 25-30.

25 Falcon(Landseer)

26 Fish hawk (Audubon)

27 Kingfisher (van Gogh)

28 Portrait of William Wells

29 Vairumati(Gauguin)

30 Portrait of Giovanni de Medici

Personal meanings
A a childhood memory
B hope for the future
C fast movement
D a potential threat
E the power of colour
F the continuity of life
G protection of nature
H a confused attitude to nature

transcript.en: How are you getting on with your art project, Tom?
transcript.zh: 汤姆，你的艺术项目进展如何？

transcript.en: OK. Like, they gave us the theme of birds to base our project on, and I'm not really all that interested in wildlife.
transcript.zh: 好的。是这样的，他们给了我们鸟类的主题作为我们项目的基础，而我对野生动物并不是很感兴趣。

transcript.en: But I'm starting to get into it. I've pretty well finished the introductory stage.
transcript.zh: 但我已经开始着手了。我已经很好地完成了入门阶段。

transcript.en: So have I. When they gave us all those handouts with details of books and websites to look at,I was really put off,
transcript.zh: 我也是。当他们给我们所有那些关于书籍和网站的详细资料时，我真的被劝退了，

transcript.en: but the more I read, the more interested I got.
transcript.zh: 但是我读得越多，我就越感兴趣。

transcript.en: Me too. I found I could research so many different aspects of birds in art-colour, movement, texture.
transcript.zh: 我也是。我发现我可以从艺术的角度研究鸟类的许多不同方面——颜色、运动和质地。

transcript.en: So I was looking forward to the Bird Park visit.
transcript.zh: 所以我很期待参观鸟类公园。

transcript.en: What a letdown! It poured with rain and we hardly saw a single bird.
transcript.zh: 真让人失望！倾盆大雨，我们几乎看不到一只鸟。

transcript.en: Much less use than the trip to the Natural History Museum,
transcript.zh: 比去自然历史博物馆少了很多价值。

transcript.en: Yeah. I liked all the stuff about evolution there.The workshop sessions with Dr Fletcher were good too, especially the brainstorming sessions.
transcript.zh: 是啊。我喜欢那里所有关于进化的东西。与弗莱彻博士的研讨会也很好，特别是头脑风暴会议。

transcript.en: Ah I missed those because I was ill. I wish we could've seen the projects last year's students did.
transcript.zh: 我错过那些是因为我病了。我真希望我们能看到去年学生做的项目。

transcript.en: Mm. I suppose they want us to do our own thing, not copy.
transcript.zh: 嗯。我想他们想让我们做出自己的东西，而不是模仿。

transcript.en: Have you drafted your proposal yet?
transcript.zh: 你的提案起草好了吗？

transcript.en: Yes, but I haven't handed it in. I need to amend some parts.
transcript.zh: 是的，但我还没交。我需要修改一些部分。

transcript.en: I've realised the notes from my research are almost all just descriptions,I haven't actually evaluated anything. So I'll have to fix that.
transcript.zh: 我已经意识到我的研究笔记几乎都是描述，我没有真正评估过任何东西。所以我得解决这个问题。

transcript.en: Oh, I didn't know we had to do that. I'll have to look at that too.
transcript.zh: 我不知道我们还得这么做。这个我也得看看。

transcript.en: Did you do a timeline for the project?
transcript.zh: 你为这个项目制定时间表了吗?

transcript.en: Yes, and a mind map.
transcript.zh: 是的，还有思维导图。

transcript.en: Yeah, so did I. I quite enjoyed that.But it was hard having to explain the basis for my decisions in my action plan.
transcript.zh: 是啊，我也是，我很喜欢。但我很难解释我在行动计划中做出决定的依据。

transcript.en: What?
transcript.zh: 什么？

transcript.en: You know, give a rationale.
transcript.zh: 你知道的，给出一个理由。

transcript.en: I didn't realise we had to do that. OK, I can add it now.
transcript.zh: 我不知道我们必须这么做。好的，我可以现在加上去。

transcript.en: And I've done the video diary presentation, and worked out what I want my outcome to be in the project.
transcript.zh: 我已经完成了视频日记的演示，并且弄清楚了我想在这个项目中得到的结果。

transcript.en: Someone told me it's best not to be too precise about your actual outcome at this stage,so you have more scope to explore your ideas later on.
transcript.zh: 有人告诉我，在这个阶段最好不要太精确你的实际结果，这样你以后就有更多的空间去探索你的想法。

transcript.en: So I'm going to go back to my proposal to make it a bit more vague.
transcript.zh: 所以我要回到我的提议，让它更模糊一点。

transcript.en: Really? OK, I'll change that too then.
transcript.zh: 真的吗?好的。那我也改一下。

transcript.en: One part of the project I'm unsure about is where we choose some paintings of birds and say what they mean to us.
transcript.zh: 这个项目有一部分我不确定，那就是我们从哪里选择一些鸟的图画来表达他们对我们意味着什么。

transcript.en: Like, I chose a painting of a falcon by Landseer. I like it because the bird's standing there with his head turned to one side,
transcript.zh: 比如，我选了一幅兰西尔的猎鹰画。我喜欢它是因为那只鸟站在那里，头转向一边，

transcript.en: but he seems to be staring straight at you. But I can't just say it's a bit scary, can I?
transcript.zh: 但它似乎在直直地盯着你。但我不能只是说这有点吓人，对吧?

transcript.en: You could talk about the possible danger suggested by the bird's look.
transcript.zh: 你可以谈谈鸟的外表可能暗示的危险。

transcript.en: Oh, OK.
transcript.zh: 噢,好的。

transcript.en: There's a picture of a fish hawk by Audubon I like.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢奥杜邦的一幅鱼鹰画。

transcript.en: It's swooping over the water with a fish in its talons,and with great black wings which take up most of the picture.
transcript.zh: 它的爪子里夹着一条鱼在水面上猛扑过来，黑色的大翅膀占据了大部分画面。

transcript.en: So you could discuss it in relation to predators and food chains?
transcript.zh: 所以你可以把它和捕食者与食物链联系起来讨论?

transcript.en: Well actually I think I'll concentrate on the impression of rapid motion it gives.
transcript.zh: 实际上，我想我会专注于它给人的动作迅速的印象。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: Do you know that picture of a kingfisher by van Gogh-it's perching on a reed growing near a stream.
transcript.zh: 你知道梵高画的翠鸟吗?它栖息在小溪附近的芦苇上。

transcript.en: Yes it's got these beautiful blue and red and black shades.
transcript.zh: 是的，它有这些漂亮的蓝色、红色和黑色阴影。

transcript.en: Mm hm.I've actually chosen it because I saw a real kingfisher once when I was little,I was out walking with my grandfather,and I've never forgotten it.
transcript.zh: 嗯嗯。我之所以选择这只翠鸟，是因为我小时候和祖父一起出去散步时看到过一只真正的翠鸟，我从未忘记过它。

transcript.en: So we can use a personal link?
transcript.zh: 所以我们可以用个人联系吗?

transcript.en: Sure.
transcript.zh: 当然。

transcript.en: OK. There's a portrait called William Wells, I can't remember the artist but it's a middle-aged man who’s just shot a bird.
transcript.zh: 好的。有一幅画像叫威廉·威尔斯，我不记得是谁画的了，是一个中年男子，他刚射中了一只鸟。

transcript.en: And his expression, and the way he's holding the bird in his hand suggests he's not sure about what he's done.
transcript.zh: 他的表情，他手里捉着鸟的方式表明他不确定自己做了什么。

transcript.en: To me it's about how ambiguous people are in the way they exploit the natural world.
transcript.zh: 对我来说，它是关于人们在开发自然世界的过程中是如何模棱两可的。

transcript.en: Interesting. There's Gauguin's picture Vairumati. He did it in Tahiti.
transcript.zh: 有趣。这是高更的画Vairumati。他在塔希提岛完成的。

transcript.en: It's a woman with a white bird behind her that is eating a lizard,and what I'm interested in is what idea this bird refers to.
transcript.zh: 画的是一个女人身后有一只白色的鸟正在吃一只蜥蜴，我感兴趣的是这只鸟表达的是什么想法。

transcript.en: Apparently, it's a reference to the never-ending cycle of existence.
transcript.zh: 显然，它指的是永不停止的循环的存在。

transcript.en: Wow. I chose a portrait of a little boy. Giovanni de Medici.
transcript.zh: 哇。我选了一幅小男孩的肖像，乔瓦尼·德·美第奇。

transcript.en: He's holding a tiny bird in one fist, I like the way he's holding it carefully so he doesn't hurt it.
transcript.zh: 他一只手捧着一只小鸟。我喜欢他小心地拿着它，这样就不会弄伤它了。

transcript.en: Ah right.
transcript.zh: 对的。
